# OpenTempl source

Original repository: https://github.com/noah-thing/opentempl

Source revision: `015064f1005e63563f73ebe0dfbeb84d90439bcc`

Source path: `apps/editor/public/templates/food-menu.json` (9 menu documents). Bundled exactly as source data, adapted at runtime to owner-provided menu information. Author/demo images and externally linked assets are not imported; only the design documents are retained. MIT license reproduced in LICENSE. No OpenTempl service, account, or API is used.

The generic owner-data adaptation is ours and is not an OpenTempl native feature.
